    Bug 2024755 - Add 7-zip to more jobs. r=sking DONTBUILD
    
    Based on searching taskcluster/kinds, I *think* these are all the tasks still missing 7-zip in
    comm/taskcluster/kinds.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D289136

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
index f9a67a79a92..c6c800b5fef 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
@@ -51,6 +51,7 @@ tasks:
                         - linux64-libdmg
                         - linux64-hfsplus
                     win.*:
+                        - linux64-7zz
                         - linux64-upx
                         - linux64-wine
                         - nsis
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml
index 091b995b28e..6677b282022 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml
@@ -67,6 +67,7 @@ tasks:
                 win64.*: [mar, installer]
         fetches:
             toolchain:
+                - linux64-7zz
                 - linux64-mar-tools
                 - linux64-upx
         treeherder-group: L10n-Rpk
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/searchfox/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/searchfox/kind.yml
index 660821e7dbb..d58819aebf0 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/searchfox/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/searchfox/kind.yml
@@ -134,6 +134,7 @@ tasks:
                 mozconfig_platform: win64
         fetches:
             toolchain:
+                - linux64-7zz
                 - linux64-cbindgen
                 - linux64-clang
                 - linux64-dump_syms
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
index 8d3888a9feb..acc6589269a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/shippable-l10n/kind.yml
@@ -60,6 +60,7 @@ tasks:

                         - linux64-hfsplus
                     win.*:

                         - linux64-upx
                         - linux64-wine
                         - nsis
